                      window.modelTextEditor.markClean();
                      window.outputTemplateEditor.markClean();
                      menuBar.setSaveState("saved");
                    } else {
                      menuBar.setSaveState("unsaved");
                    }
                    this.saveSuccessCallback(data.name, data.publicId);
            
                    menuBar.refs.statusMessage.innerHTML = "<b>(new generator created)</b>";
                    menuBar.refs.statusMessage.style.display = "inline-flex";
                    setTimeout(() => {
                      menuBar.refs.statusMessage.innerHTML = "";
                      menuBar.refs.statusMessage.style.display = "none";
                    }, 4000);

                    if(!this.store.data.user.loggedIn) {
                      inMemoryGeneratorNameToEditKey[data.name] = data.editKey;
                      prompt("New generator created. If you'd like to edit it in the future, you'll need to use the following password. Please copy and paste it somewhere safe:", data.editKey);
                      if(confirm(`You can click OK to save this password to your temporary browser storage, so you don't have to enter the password every time you make an edit. You should 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸 𝗰𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗹 if you're using a shared computer (e.g. at library). Note: If your cookies/storage for this site are cleared, your saved passwords will be cleared.`)) {
                        localStorage[`perchance_generatorEditKey_${data.name}`] = data.editKey;
                      } else {
                        doNotAskToSaveEditPasswordFor.add(data.name);
                      }
                    }
                    window.hardReloadOutputIframe().catch(console.error);
            
                  } else if(data.status === "invalid-edit-key") {
                    delete localStorage[`perchance_generatorEditKey_${this.data.generator.name}`];
                    menuBar.setSaveState("error");
                    setTimeout(() => { menuBar.setSaveState("unsaved"); }, 1000);
                    alert("The edit password was incorrect. Please try again.");
                  } else if(data.status === "session-token-error") {
            
                    this.logout();
                    this.openLoginModal();
                    menuBar.setSaveState("error");
                    setTimeout(() => { menuBar.setSaveState("unsaved"); }, 1000);
            
                  } else if(data.status === "too-big") {
                    menuBar.setSaveState("error");
                    alert("Hmm. There's too much text in this generator to save it to Perchance's database. :| Can you perhaps break it into several smaller generators that you import into the main one? Note that perchance.org/upload can be used to upload large amounts of data.");
                    setTimeout(() => { menuBar.setSaveState("unsaved"); }, 1000);
                  } else if(data.status === "too-many-requests") {
                    menuBar.setSaveState("error");
                    alert(`You're saving too quickly!${this.store.data.user.loggedIn ? " Please try again in a few seconds." : " If you're not saving quickly, then this 𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝗯𝗲 𝗰𝗮𝘂𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗯𝘆 𝗮 𝗩𝗣𝗡 browser extension - try disabling it, or logging in."}`);
                    setTimeout(() => { menuBar.setSaveState("unsaved"); }, 1000);
                  } else if(typeof data.status === "string" && data.status.startsWith("src-")) {
                    menuBar.setSaveState("error");
                    let srcMessages = {
                      "src-too-big": "Your src files total more than the 100MB limit. Remove some files from the files panel (large stable assets are better served by the upload tool), then save again.",
                      "src-too-many-files": "Your src folder has more than 1000 files. Remove some from the files panel, then save again.",
                      "src-manifest-invalid": "One of your src file paths isn't valid (letters/numbers/dot/dash/underscore only, max 10 folders deep). Rename the offending file in the files panel and save again.",
                      "src-file-missing": "The server couldn't verify one of your src files with the file storage. Try saving again — if it keeps failing, re-create the file so it re-uploads.",
                      "src-verify-unavailable": "The file storage service couldn't be reached to verify your src files. Your generator was NOT saved — try again in a minute.",
                    };
                    alert(srcMessages[data.status] || ("Couldn't save the src files (" + data.status + "). Your generator was NOT saved."));
                    setTimeout(() => { menuBar.setSaveState("unsaved"); }, 1000);
                  } else {
                    console.error("Server error while saving:", data);
                    menuBar.setSaveState("error");
                    alert("Seems like there was a problem while trying to save your generator. This could be to do with your internet connection, but it could also be a temporary problem with the server. Please copy and paste your generator data (lists and HTML) to a safe place before leaving or refreshing the page, or you could lose your work. If you keep getting errors even after waiting a couple of minutes, please make a post on lemmy.world/c/perchance to see if others are experiencing the same thing. Remember that you can click the \"backups\" button in the top-right of the screen to download past versions of your generator. Before doing anything though, make sure you copy and paste your data to a safe place! Sorry for the trouble - this stuff happens sometimes :|");
                    setTimeout(() => { menuBar.setSaveState("unsaved"); }, 1000);
                  }
            
                  // track generator save times so we can cache bust if cloudflare cache puring is delayed (see code at bottom of index.html template)
                  if(data.status === "saved" || data.status === "created") {
                    let generatorSavedTimes = JSON.parse(localStorage["generatorSavedTimes"] || "{}");
                    generatorSavedTimes[this.data.generator.name] = Date.now();
                    // clear old save times (older than 3 months, since the cache definitely shouldn't last any longer than that, even if a manual purge isn't initiated):
                    generatorSavedTimes = Object.fromEntries( Object.entries(generatorSavedTimes).filter(e => e[1] > Date.now()-1000*60*60*24*30) );
                    localStorage["generatorSavedTimes"] = JSON.stringify(generatorSavedTimes);

                    if(!localStorage.generatorsLikelyOwned || !localStorage.generatorsLikelyOwned.includes(`,${this.data.generator.name},`)) localStorage.generatorsLikelyOwned = (localStorage.generatorsLikelyOwned || "") + `,${this.data.generator.name},`;
                  }
                } catch(e) {
                  console.error("Request error while saving:");
                  console.error(e);
                  menuBar.setSaveState("error");
                  setTimeout(() => { menuBar.setSaveState("unsaved"); }, 1000);
                } finally {
                  // a collaborator's checkpoint that arrived while our save was in flight was
                  // deferred (adopting mid-prepareForSave could mix manifest bases) — apply it
                  // now that the save has settled, whatever the outcome
                  try { if(window.saveCheckpointManager) window.saveCheckpointManager.adoptPending(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
                }

              window.userOwnsThisGenerator = undefined; // IMPORTANT: this must be undefined while we don't know - there is code which relies on this.

          window.downloadTextFile = (text, name) => {

            if(!window.diff_match_patch) {

              window.diffStuff._patchesToRevision = (patches, revisionNumber) => {
                if(revisionNumber > patches.length-1 || revisionNumber < 0) throw new Error(`revisionNumber ${revisionNumber} doesn't exist. max index of patches array = ${patches.length-1}`);
                let text = patches[0];
                if(revisionNumber === 0) return text;
                for(let n = 1; n < patches.length; n++) {
                  //text = JsDiff.applyPatch(text, patches[n]);
                  text = dmp.patch_apply(dmp.patch_fromText(patches[n]), text)[0];
                  if(text === false) throw new Error("JsDiff says that the patches aren't correct. some sort of corruption or incorrect formatting or mismatch");
                  if(n === revisionNumber) return text;
                }
              };
            }

            modelText = decodeURI(modelText);

        <script>
          (async function() {

            async function sha256Text(text) {
              const msgUint8 = new TextEncoder().encode(text);                          
              const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', msgUint8);          
              const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));                    
              const hashHex = hashArray.map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
              return hashHex;
            }

            async function sendNotification(data) {
              // safety code to prevent duplicate notifications (shouldn't be needed, but just in case):
              let hash = await sha256Text(JSON.stringify(data));
              if(!localStorage.alreadyRecentlySentNotificationHashes) localStorage.alreadyRecentlySentNotificationHashes = "";
              if(localStorage.alreadyRecentlySentNotificationHashes.includes(hash)) return;
              localStorage.alreadyRecentlySentNotificationHashes += ","+hash;
              if(localStorage.alreadyRecentlySentNotificationHashes.length > 2000) localStorage.alreadyRecentlySentNotificationHashes = localStorage.alreadyRecentlySentNotificationHashes.slice(-1000);
              
              let notification;
              if(Notification.permission === "granted") {
                notification = new Notification(data.title, {body:data.body});
              } else if(Notification.permission !== "denied") {
                const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
                if(permission === "granted") {
                  notification = new Notification(title, options);
                }
              }
              return notification;
            }

            window.addEventListener("message", async function(e) {
              let origin = e.origin || e.originalEvent.origin; // For Chrome, the origin property is in the event.originalEvent object.
              if(origin !== "https://comments-plugin.perchance.org") {
                return;
              }
              if(e.data.type === "ensure-notification-permission") {
                if(Notification.permission !== "granted" && Notification.permission !== "denied") {
                  const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
                  if(permission === "granted") {
                    console.debug("notification permission granted");
                  } else {
                    console.debug("notification permission denied");
                  }
                }
              } else if(e.data.type === "notification-request") {
                if(Notification.permission !== "denied") {
                  if(e.data.folderName.split("+")[0] === window.location.pathname.slice(1)) {
                    let notification = await sendNotification(e.data).catch(e => console.error(e));
                    if(notification) notification.onclick = function() { window.focus(); this.close(); };
                  } else {
                    console.debug("Pending notification:", e.data.title, e.data.body, e.data.folderName);
                    // we ideally want this notification to be triggered in an already-open tab of the relevant generator (because then the notification.onclick can focus that tab, rather than opening a duplicate of that tab), so we put the notification data in localStorage and wait a few seconds for the relevant tab to take it out, and if not, then we trigger it from this tab, and set onclick to open a new tab
                    if(!localStorage.pendingNotifications) localStorage.pendingNotifications = "[]";
                    let pendingNotifications;
                    try { pendingNotifications = JSON.parse(localStorage.pendingNotifications); } catch(e) { console.error("failed to parse pending notifications", e); pendingNotifications = []; }
                    pendingNotifications.push(e.data);
                    localStorage.pendingNotifications = JSON.stringify(pendingNotifications);

                    // try to wake the target tab with a BroadcastChannel message (no idea if this helps, but can't hurt):
                    let broadcastChannel;
                    if(window.BroadcastChannel) {
                      broadcastChannel = new BroadcastChannel("generatorName:"+window.location.pathname.slice(1));
                      broadcastChannel.postMessage({type:"wake-up"});
                    }
                    
                    setTimeout(async function() {
                      if(broadcastChannel) broadcastChannel.close();
                      let pendingNotifications;
                      try { pendingNotifications = JSON.parse(localStorage.pendingNotifications); } catch(e) { console.error("failed to parse pending notifications", e); pendingNotifications = []; }
                      let notificationData = pendingNotifications.find(d => d.time === e.data.time && d.folderName === e.data.folderName && d.title === e.data.title && d.body === e.data.body);
                      if(notificationData) {
                        let notification = await sendNotification(notificationData).catch(e => console.error(e));
                        if(notification) notification.onclick = function() { window.open(`/${notificationData.folderName.split("+")[0]}`, "_blank"); this.close(); };
                        pendingNotifications = pendingNotifications.filter(d => d !== notificationData);
                        localStorage.pendingNotifications = JSON.stringify(pendingNotifications);
                      }
                    }, 1000*7); // <-- 'pending notification' timeout length (before we give up and just sent the `Notification` from this tab)
                  }
                }
              }
            });

            (async function() {

              if(window.BroadcastChannel) {
                let channel = new BroadcastChannel("generatorName:"+window.location.pathname.slice(1));
                channel.onmessage = (event) => {
                  if(event.data.type === "wake-up") {
                    console.debug("received wake-up message at:", new Date().toString());
                  }
                };
              }

              while(1) {
                let generatorName = window.location.pathname.slice(1);
                try {
                  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000*2)); // this wait time must be lower than the 'pending notification' timeout length above
                  // parse localStorage.pendingNotifications and trigger notification if generatorName matches folderName
                  if(!localStorage.pendingNotifications) localStorage.pendingNotifications = "[]";
                  let pendingNotifications;
                  try { pendingNotifications = JSON.parse(localStorage.pendingNotifications); } catch(e) { console.error("failed to parse pending notifications", e); pendingNotifications = []; }
                  
                  let pendingNotificationsForThisGeneratorName = pendingNotifications.filter(n => n.folderName.split("+")[0] === generatorName);
                  for(let notificationData of pendingNotificationsForThisGeneratorName) {
                    let notification = await sendNotification(notificationData).catch(e => console.error(e));
                    if(notification) notification.onclick = function() { window.focus(); this.close(); };
                    pendingNotifications = pendingNotifications.filter(n => n !== notificationData);
                  }
                  localStorage.pendingNotifications = JSON.stringify(pendingNotifications);
                } catch(e) { console.error(e) }
              }
            })();

          })();
        </script>

        <script>
          function createAdCtn() {
            let adCtn = window[doc34828272947].createElement("div");
            adCtn.id = "adCtn";
            adCtn.style.cssText = `padding:0; min-height:${window.advertHeight}px !important; max-height:${window.advertHeight}px !important; height:${window.advertHeight}px !important; overflow:hidden !important; text-align:center; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; position:relative;`;
            return adCtn;
          }

          // Invisible "double-tap" shield over the ad to prevent real-user mis-clicks
          // (the ad sits at the bottom of the screen, right where the mobile keyboard pops up). The first tap is swallowed and
          // reveals a "tap again" message with the ad slightly dimmed; the shield re-arms after 10 seconds.
          window.adShieldEnabled = true;

          function addAdShield() {
            if(!window.adShieldEnabled) return;
            if(!window.adCtn || window.adCtn.querySelector("#adShieldEl")) return;

            let shieldEl = window[doc34828272947].createElement("div");
            shieldEl.id = "adShieldEl";
            shieldEl.style.cssText = `position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:2147483600; background:transparent; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; user-select:none; -webkit-user-select:none; touch-action:manipulation; transition:background 0.15s;`;

            let styleEl = window[doc34828272947].createElement("style");
            styleEl.textContent = `@keyframes adShieldPressAnim { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translateY(2px) scale(0.8); } }`;
            shieldEl.appendChild(styleEl);

            let msgEl = window[doc34828272947].createElement("div");
            msgEl.style.cssText = `display:none; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.75); color:#fff; font-family:sans-serif; font-size:13px; line-height:1.2; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:100px; pointer-events:none;`;
            msgEl.innerHTML = `<span style="display:inline-block; font-size:16px; animation:adShieldPressAnim 0.9s ease-in-out infinite;">👆</span><span>tap ad again to open (new tab)</span>`;
            shieldEl.appendChild(msgEl);

            let rearmTimeout = null;
            function arm() {
              clearTimeout(rearmTimeout);
              shieldEl.dataset.state = "armed";
              shieldEl.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
              shieldEl.style.background = "transparent";
              msgEl.style.display = "none";
            }
            function disarm(showMessage) {
              // pointer-events:none means the second tap (and elementsFromPoint hit-testing) goes straight through to the ad
              shieldEl.dataset.state = "disarmed";
              shieldEl.style.pointerEvents = "none";
              if(showMessage) {
                shieldEl.style.background = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)"; // dim the ad slightly so the message stands out
                msgEl.style.display = "flex";
              }
              clearTimeout(rearmTimeout);
              rearmTimeout = setTimeout(arm, 10*1000);
            }

            // IMPORTANT: disarm on 'click' (i.e. after pointerup), NOT on pointerdown - click hit-testing happens at pointerup
            // time, so going pointer-events:none on pointerdown would deliver this same first tap's click to the ad underneath.
            shieldEl.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
              if(shieldEl.dataset.state !== "armed") return;
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              let usableAd = adCtnHasUsableAdAtCenter();
              disarm(usableAd); // if the ad slot is empty/failed, disarm silently rather than showing "tap again" over nothing
              if(usableAd) window.queuedStatCountKeys.add("adshld1"); // first tap swallowed while a real ad was showing
            });

            // Second-tap proxy: clicking through to the ad iframe moves focus into it, blurring this window.
            window.addEventListener("blur", function() {
              if(shieldEl.dataset.state === "disarmed" && window[doc34828272947].activeElement && window.adCtn.contains(window[doc34828272947].activeElement)) {
                window.queuedStatCountKeys.add("adshld2"); // user followed through with the second tap
              }
            });

            arm();
            window.adCtn.appendChild(shieldEl);
          }

                    ['/', '/subdomain', ''].forEach(path => document.cookie = `${name}=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT;path=${path};domain=${window.location.hostname}`);
                    if(document.cookie.length <= 3900) break;
                  }
                }
              }, 5*1000);
            }


            {
              // Ensure adCtn style can't be changed:
              let lastStyleChangeTime = 0;
              const originalStyle = window.adCtn.getAttribute('style');
              const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
                mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
                  if(mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'style') {
                    if(window.adCtn.getAttribute('style') !== originalStyle) {
                      if(Date.now()-lastStyleChangeTime > 1000) { // prevent possible infinite loops (setInterval below is a backup)
                        window.adCtn.setAttribute('style', originalStyle);
                        lastStyleChangeTime = Date.now();
                      }
                    }
                  }
                });
              });
              const config = { attributes:true, attributeFilter:['style'] };
              observer.observe(window.adCtn, config);

            let deletionsInLastFewSeconds = 0;

              deletionsInLastFewSeconds = 0;

            function deleteMisplacedAdElements() {
              if(deletionsInLastFewSeconds > 100) {
                window.queuedStatCountKeys.add("misplaced-ad-loop");
                return; // in case of infinite loop that would freeze the page (e.g. "fighting" with a modal that self-heals or something weird like that)
              }
              let points = getElementKeyPointsInset(document.querySelector("#outputIframeEl"), {insetFactor:0.2});
              points.push(...getElementKeyPointsInset(document.querySelector("#outputIframeEl"), {insetFactor:0.03}));
              let appEl = document.querySelector("#appEl"); 
              for(let {x, y} of points) {
                let elements = document.elementsFromPoint(x, y);
                for(let el of elements) {
                  if(el === document.body || el === document.documentElement) continue;
                  if(!document.body.contains(el)) continue; // in case it was deleted by a previous iteration of this current loop
                  if(appEl.contains(el)) continue;
                  if(el.nodeName !== "IFRAME" || !el.src.includes(".perchance.org")) {
                    let ancestor = el;
                    while(ancestor.parentElement !== document.body) ancestor = ancestor.parentElement;
                    if(appEl.contains(ancestor)) {
                      console.error("Tried to remove a child of appEl?");
                      continue; 
                    }
                    const className = ancestor.className || "";
                    const id = ancestor.id || "";
                    if(className.startsWith("cmp") || className.includes("-cmp") || className.includes("cmp2") || id.includes("cmp") || id.includes("termly") || className.includes("termly") || className.startsWith("sp_") || id.startsWith("sp_")) { // gdpr consent modal
                      continue;
                    }
                    if(id.includes("confiant")) continue; // ad report button
                    if(id.startsWith("ura_")) continue; // ad report button
                    if(className.includes("created-captcha-widget-ctn")) {
                      continue;
                    }
                    ancestor.remove();
                    deletionsInLastFewSeconds++;
                    console.warn("🧹🧹🧹 Deleted misplaced element ancestor:", {el, ancestor});
                    window.queuedStatCountKeys.add("misplaced-ad");
                  }
                }
              } 
            }

            function insetPointTowardCenter(x, y, centerX, centerY, insetFactor) {
              return { x: x + (centerX - x) * insetFactor, y: y + (centerY - y) * insetFactor };
            }
            function getElementKeyPointsInset(element, opts={}) {
              const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
              const centerX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
              const centerY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
              const insetFactor = opts.insetFactor ?? 0.2; // default to 20% inset

              const topLeft = insetPointTowardCenter(rect.left, rect.top, centerX, centerY, insetFactor);
              const topRight = insetPointTowardCenter(rect.right, rect.top, centerX, centerY, insetFactor);
              const bottomRight = insetPointTowardCenter(rect.right, rect.bottom, centerX, centerY, insetFactor);
              const bottomLeft = insetPointTowardCenter(rect.left, rect.bottom, centerX, centerY, insetFactor);

              return [ topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft, { x: centerX, y: centerY }];
            }

            const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutationsList, observer) {
              for(let mutation of mutationsList) {
                if(mutation.type === 'childList') {
                  mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
                    if(node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                      // console.debug('Checking new potential ad element for misplacement:', node);
                      deleteMisplacedAdElements();

                          }, 5000); // for dynamic re-render delay, which CMP does (sometimes?)
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  });
                }
              }
            });
            observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
          })();

        <!-- AI helper (agentic). Loads lazily when the user enters EDIT MODE — a normal page
             view never fetches this script. Sessions are created even more lazily (on the
             user's first message), so lookers cost the agent server nothing. -->
        <script>
          {
            (function () {
              var loaded = false;
              function randomTabId() {
                try { return "t" + Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12)), function (b) { return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"); }).join(""); }
                catch (e) { return "t" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36); }
              }
              // Duplicate Tab copies sessionStorage.  Hold the id's Web Lock for this page's
              // whole lifetime; if a copied id is already held, rotate before any recovery,
              // resume, attach, or reservation request uses it.
              window.__claimAiAgentTabIdentity = function () {
                if (window.__aiAgentTabIdentityPromise) return window.__aiAgentTabIdentityPromise;
                window.__aiAgentTabIdentityPromise = (async function () {
                  var id;
                  try { id = sessionStorage.aiAgentTabId || randomTabId(); } catch (e) { id = randomTabId(); }
                  if (!(navigator.locks && navigator.locks.request)) {
                    window.__aiAgentTabLockUnsupported = true;
                    return { tabId: id, tabLockV1: false };
                  }
                  for (var tries = 0; tries < 5; tries++) {
                    var claimed = await new Promise(function (resolve) {
                      navigator.locks.request("perchance-ai-tab:" + id, { mode: "exclusive", ifAvailable: true }, async function (lock) {
                        if (!lock) return resolve(false);
                        resolve(true);
                        await new Promise(function () {}); // page-lifetime ownership
                      }).catch(function () { resolve(false); });
                    });
                    if (claimed) {
                      try { sessionStorage.aiAgentTabId = id; } catch (e) {}
                      if (tries) window.__aiAgentTabIdentityRotated = true;
                      return { tabId: id, tabLockV1: true };
                    }
                    id = randomTabId();
                  }
                  window.__aiAgentTabLockClaimFailed = true;
                  return { tabId: id, tabLockV1: false };
                })();
                return window.__aiAgentTabIdentityPromise;
              };
              function loadAgent() {
                if (loaded) return;
                loaded = true;
                window.__claimAiAgentTabIdentity();
                var el = document.createElement("script");
                // auto-versioned from the asset files' mtimes (see aiAgentAssetsVersion in main.js);
                // /lib/ because Cloudflare respects the ?v= query in the cache key there (it ignores queries on root-level files)
                window.__aiAgentAssetsVersion = "msvteuko";
                el.src = "/lib/aiAgentClient.js?v=msvteuko";
                el.async = true;
                document.body.appendChild(el);
                loadSrcModule();
                loadCheckpointModule();
                loadRecoveryFlow();
              }
              // Crash/refresh recovery (non-collab): if a previous session left an unsaved
              // stash (code) or a dirty /src overlay (files), offer ONE restore/discard
              // choice — text and files travel together (they save atomically too).
              function loadRecoveryFlow() {
                var settle;
                window.__recoveryFlowSettled = new Promise(function (r) { settle = r; });
                (async function () {
                  var recoveryMutationStarted = false;
                  try {
                    // never compare against a stale cached render; but the verification
                    // promise hangs forever on network errors/webdriver, so race it
                    var raceResult = await Promise.race([
                      window.thisIsNotAnOldCachedPagePromise,
                      new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(function () { r("timeout"); }, 5000); }),
                    ]);
                    for (var i = 0; i < 60 && !(window.modelTextEditor && window.srcState); i++) await new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, 500); });
                    if (!window.modelTextEditor || !window.srcState) { console.debug("recoveryFlow: no-editors"); return settle(null); }
                    await window.srcState.ready();
                    if (window.yjsProvider) { console.debug("recoveryFlow: skip-collab"); return settle(null); } // collab: the room durably holds unsaved text; src overlay persists silently as before
                    // no ownership gate — mirrors the stash writer (logged-out owners and
                    // non-owners get recovery too; see stashRecoveryIfNeeded)
                    var gen = window.app.data.generator.name;
                    var stash = await window.kv.recoveryStash.get(gen);
                    var srcDirty = window.srcState.isDirty();
                    var stashDiffers = !!stash && (stash.modelText !== window.modelTextEditor.getValue() || stash.outputTemplate !== window.outputTemplateEditor.getValue());
                    if (!stashDiffers && !srcDirty) {
                      console.debug("recoveryFlow: clean (stash=" + !!stash + " srcDirty=" + srcDirty + ")"); if (stash) await window.kv.recoveryStash.delete(gen); // stashed content is exactly what is loaded = already saved
                      return settle(null);                    }
                    var sidRec = null;
                    try { sidRec = JSON.parse(localStorage["aiAgentSid:" + gen] || "null"); } catch (e) {}
                    var identity = await window.__claimAiAgentTabIdentity();
                    var recoveryApi = function (path, body) {
                      return fetch("https://ai-agent.perchance.org/api/aiAgent/" + path, {
                        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body),
                      }).then(async function (r) {
                        var payload;
                        try { payload = await r.json(); }
                        catch (e) { throw new Error("AI recovery returned an unreadable response"); }
                        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(String(payload && payload.error || "AI recovery request failed (HTTP " + r.status + ")"));
                        if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object") throw new Error("AI recovery returned an invalid response");
                        return payload;
                      });
                    };
                    var recoveryBeacon = function (kind, detail) {
                      recoveryApi("clientLog", { kind: kind, detail: String(detail || "").slice(0, 300), cv: 14 }).catch(function () {});
                    };
                    var status = { state: "gone" };
                    if (sidRec && sidRec.sid) {
                      try {
                        status = await recoveryApi("recoveryStatus", { sessionId: sidRec.sid, tabId: identity.tabId, tabLockV1: identity.tabLockV1 });
                      } catch (e) { status = { state: "unknown" }; }
                      if (!status || ["unsafe", "idle", "gone", "unknown"].indexOf(status.state) < 0) status = { state: "unknown" };
                      if (!status || status.state === "unknown") {
                        recoveryBeacon("recovery-probe-unknown", "status unavailable");
                        alert("Your browser still has unsaved recovery data, but the earlier AI session could not be checked safely. Nothing was changed or restored. Reload when the connection is working to retry recovery; an AI request sent now will use the code currently visible in the editor.");
                        return settle("skipped-unknown");
                      }
                      if (status.state === "unsafe") {
                        recoveryBeacon("recovery-probe-unsafe", status.reason || "unsafe");
                        var unsafeText = status.reason === "attached-idle"
                          ? "Close other tabs showing this generator, or—if one was just closed—wait up to about six minutes and retry."
                          : "The earlier AI session still has active, queued, restarting, or reserved work. Close this recovery prompt and retry after that work finishes.";
                        alert("Your browser kept unsaved recovery data and did not apply or discard it.\n\n" + unsafeText);
                        return settle("skipped-unsafe");
                      }
                    }
                    // another LIVE tab editing this generator answers within ~400ms — then
                    // this isn't crash recovery; skip the modal (never clear the stash on
                    // this signal alone)
                    var otherTabAlive = await new Promise(function (resolve) {
                      try {
                        var ch = new BroadcastChannel("perchance-editor-liveness");
                        var done = function (v) { try { ch.close(); } catch (e) {} resolve(v); };
                        ch.onmessage = function (e) { if (e.data && e.data.type === "pong" && e.data.gen === gen && e.data.to === window.__livenessTabId) done(true); };
                        ch.postMessage({ type: "ping", gen: gen, from: window.__livenessTabId });
                        setTimeout(function () { done(false); }, 400);
                      } catch (e) { resolve(false); }
                    });
                    if (otherTabAlive) { console.debug("recoveryFlow: other-tab-alive"); recoveryBeacon("recovery-probe-changed", "browser liveness response"); return settle("skipped-other-tab"); }
                    var cautions = "";
                    if (raceResult === "timeout") cautions += "\n\n(Couldn't verify that this page shows the latest saved version — if your connection is flaky, be careful.)";
                    if (stashDiffers && stash.baseSaveCount !== undefined && window.generatorSaveCountKnown && stash.baseSaveCount !== window.generatorSaveCount) {
                      cautions += "\n\nNote: this generator was saved again (possibly in another tab or on another device) AFTER these changes were made. Restoring brings back your older working copy.";
                      // only point at the backups button for users who actually HAVE it (same
                      // visibility rule as the button itself: logged-in owner, see menuBar)
                      var hasBackupsButton = false;
                      try { hasBackupsButton = !!(window.app.store.data.user.loggedIn && window.userOwnsThisGenerator); } catch (e) {}
                      if (hasBackupsButton) cautions += " Every saved version stays available via the 𝗯𝗮𝗰𝗸𝘂𝗽𝘀 button.";
                    }
                    var restore = confirm("You have unsaved changes for this generator stored in your browser (from a previous session that didn't save)." + cautions + "\n\nClick OK to RESTORE them into the editor, or Cancel to DISCARD them.");
                    var decisionGeneration = Date.now() + Math.random();
                    var lease = null;
                    try {
                      if (sidRec && sidRec.sid) {
                        lease = await recoveryApi("reserve", {
                          sessionId: sidRec.sid, tabId: identity.tabId, tabLockV1: identity.tabLockV1,
                          attemptID: "recovery-" + String(decisionGeneration).replace(".", "-"), purpose: "recovery",
                        });
                        if (!lease || !(lease.state === "gone" || (lease.ok && lease.token))) throw new Error((lease && lease.error) || "recovery authority changed");
                        if (lease.state !== "gone") {
                          for (var waitAttach = 0; waitAttach < 150 && typeof window.__aiAgentRecoveryAttach !== "function"; waitAttach++) await new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, 100); });
                          if (typeof window.__aiAgentRecoveryAttach !== "function") throw new Error("AI recovery attachment did not become ready");
                          await window.__aiAgentRecoveryAttach(sidRec.sid);
                        }
                      } else {
                        lease = { state: "gone" }; // no AI sid exists to resurrect or race
                      }
                      var authorityLive = function () {
                        return decisionGeneration && lease && (lease.state === "gone" || (lease.token && Date.now() < lease.expiresAt));
                      };
                      if (!authorityLive()) throw new Error("recovery authority expired before mutation");
                      if (restore) {
                        if (stashDiffers) {
                          if (!authorityLive()) throw new Error("recovery authority expired");
                          recoveryMutationStarted = true;
                          window.modelTextEditor.setValue(stash.modelText);
                          if (!authorityLive()) throw new Error("recovery authority expired");
                          window.outputTemplateEditor.setValue(stash.outputTemplate);
                        }
                        settle("restored");
                      } else {
                        if (!authorityLive()) throw new Error("recovery authority expired");
                        if (srcDirty) {
                          if (!authorityLive()) throw new Error("recovery authority expired");
                          recoveryMutationStarted = true;
                          await window.srcState.resetToSaved();
                        }
                        if (!authorityLive()) throw new Error("recovery authority expired");
                        recoveryMutationStarted = true;
                        await window.kv.recoveryStash.delete(gen);
                        settle("discarded");
                      }
                    } finally {
                      if (lease && lease.token && sidRec && sidRec.sid) recoveryApi("release", { sessionId: sidRec.sid, token: lease.token }).catch(function () {});
                    }
                  } catch (e) {
                    console.error("recovery flow failed:", e);
                    try { recoveryBeacon("recovery-failure", String(e && e.message || e)); } catch (_) {}
                    if (recoveryMutationStarted) {
                      window.__aiAgentRecoveryFatal = true;
                      alert("Recovery stopped after it had begun changing browser state. Do not send an AI request from this page; reload and retry.\n\n" + String(e && e.message || e));
                      settle("fatal");
                    } else {
                      alert("Recovery could not be completed safely, so nothing was changed. Reload to retry recovery; an AI request sent now will use the code currently visible in the editor.\n\n" + String(e && e.message || e));
                      settle("skipped-failure");
                    }
                  }
                })();
              }
              // /src file trees: load the module for every edit-mode session (was gated by
              // localStorage.__srcFilesEnabled during the tester rollout, 2026-07-24/25).
              function loadSrcModule() {
                var el = document.createElement("script");
                el.src = "/lib/srcFiles.js?v=msvteuko";
                el.async = true;
                el.onload = function () {
                  try {
                    window.srcState = window.PerchanceSrc.createSrcState({
                      generatorName: window.app.data.generator.name,
                      savedManifest: window.app.data.generator.srcManifest || {},
                      lastEditTime: window.generatorLastSaveTime,
                      saveCount: window.generatorSaveCountKnown ? window.generatorSaveCount : 0,
                      getOutputIframe: function () { return document.querySelector("#outputIframeEl"); },
                      // background temp-uploads of pending files (+ upload-channel pre-warm), so
                      // saving doesn't wait on uploads — see runPreUploadPass in srcFiles.js
                      backgroundPreUploads: true,
                    });
                    // Keep the preview iframe's src resolver in sync WITHOUT reloading the
                    // preview: srcStateUpdate only refreshes the manifest/pending flags (the
                    // service worker re-asks this page for pending bytes per request anyway).
                    function pushSrcStateToIframe() {
                      var iframe = document.querySelector("#outputIframeEl");
                      if (!iframe || !iframe.contentWindow) return;
                      try {
                        iframe.contentWindow.postMessage({
                          command: "srcStateUpdate",
                          srcManifest: window.srcState.manifestForIframe(),
                          srcHasPending: window.srcState.hasPending(),
                        }, "*");
                      } catch (e) {}
                    }
                    window.srcState.ready().then(function () {
                      // background-warm the tree so agent seeding / grep / panel views are fast,
                      // and let the preview know if there's already pending (unsaved) state
                      window.srcState.preloadAll();
                      if (window.srcState.hasPending()) pushSrcStateToIframe();
                      window.srcState.onChange(function () {
                        pushSrcStateToIframe();
                        // src-only edits (rename/delete/new file with untouched code) must still
                        // arm the save button — saveGenerator early-returns unless "unsaved"
                        try { if (window.srcState.isDirty()) window.setSaveState("unsaved"); } catch (e) {}
                        // ...and a checkpoint adoption that brings us back IN SYNC with the
                        // saved state must un-arm it (owner-or-collab-capable users only)
                        try { window.recomputeSaveState(); } catch (e) {}
                      });
                      try { if (window.srcState.isDirty()) window.setSaveState("unsaved"); } catch (e) {}
                      // one-time notices from loadWorking's rebase (cross-device / migration)
                      try {
                        var loadInfo = window.srcState.getLoadInfo();
                        if (loadInfo && loadInfo.restored && loadInfo.restored.length) console.warn("src: files restored from the saved version during base migration:", loadInfo.restored);
                        if (loadInfo && loadInfo.conflicts && loadInfo.conflicts.length) console.warn("src: local and saved versions both changed (kept local; you'll confirm at save):", loadInfo.conflicts);
                      } catch (e) {}
                    });
                  } catch (e) { console.error("src module init failed:", e); }
                };
                document.body.appendChild(el);
              }
              // Save-checkpoint sync: reconciles save-state, expected version and /src base
              // with every save that happens anywhere (this tab, a collaborator, another
              // device) — via the server's checkpoint responses + the collab room's metadata.
              function loadCheckpointModule() {
                var el = document.createElement("script");
                el.src = "/lib/saveCheckpoints.js?v=msvteuko";
                el.async = true;
                el.onload = function () {
                  try {
                    var mgr = window.PerchanceSaveCheckpoints.createCheckpointManager({
                      generatorName: window.app.data.generator.name,
                      initial: { saveCount: window.generatorSaveCount, time: window.generatorLastSaveTime, saveCountKnown: window.generatorSaveCountKnown },
                      getYDoc: function () { return window.yDoc || null; },
                      getYjsProvider: function () { return window.yjsProvider || null; },
                      getSrcState: function () { return window.srcState || null; },
                      isSaving: function () { return window.perchanceSaveState === "saving"; },
                      computeRevision: function (g) { return window.getGeneratorSourceRevision(g); },
                      getEditorTexts: function () {
                        if (!window.modelTextEditor || !window.outputTemplateEditor) return null;
                        return { modelText: window.modelTextEditor.getValue(), outputTemplate: window.outputTemplateEditor.getValue() };
                      },
                      getPageSavedTexts: function () {
                        // MUST come from the immutable embed element — window.generatorData is
                        // the same object the app mutates with LIVE editor content (collab sync
                        // included), so reading it would compare the room against itself and
                        // silence divergence detection entirely
                        try {
                          var g = JSON.parse(decodeURI(document.querySelector("#preloaded-generator-data").innerText)) || {};
                          return { modelText: g.modelText || "", outputTemplate: g.outputTemplate || "" };
                        } catch (e) {
                          console.error(e);
                          return { modelText: "", outputTemplate: "" };
                        }
                      },
                      onReconciled: function (info) {
                        try {
                          // never DOWNGRADE the expected version (a same/older checkpoint can
                          // legitimately reconcile the badge, but must not roll the guard back)
                          var cpIsNotOlder = info.checkpoint.saveCount > window.generatorSaveCount ||
                            (info.checkpoint.saveCount === window.generatorSaveCount && info.checkpoint.time >= window.generatorLastSaveTime);
                          if (cpIsNotOlder) {
                            window.generatorLastSaveTime = info.checkpoint.time;
                            if (info.checkpoint.saveCount > 0) {
                              window.generatorSaveCount = info.checkpoint.saveCount;
                              window.generatorSaveCountKnown = true;
                            }
                          }
                          if (info.textMatches && window.modelTextEditor) {
                            // our exact current content IS the saved content — record that so
                            // the badge, exit warning and backup logic all read "saved"
                            window.lastModelTextSaved = window.modelTextEditor.getValue();
                            window.lastOutputTemplateSaved = window.outputTemplateEditor.getValue();
                            if (info.checkpoint.sourceRevision) window.lastSavedGeneratorSourceRevision = info.checkpoint.sourceRevision;
                            try { window.modelTextEditor.markClean(); window.outputTemplateEditor.markClean(); } catch (e) {}
                          }
                          window.recomputeSaveState();
                        } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
                      },
                      onDivergence: function (info) {
                        window.__divergenceIsBootstrap = !!(info && info.bootstrap);
                        console.warn("collab session content differs from the saved generator" + (window.__divergenceIsBootstrap ? " (pre-update session — may just be old unsaved work)" : " (a save bypassed this session)") + " — saving is gated behind a confirmation");
                      },
                      log: function (m) { console.debug("saveCheckpoints:", m); },
                    });
                    window.saveCheckpointManager = mgr;
                    // yDoc appears when the editors bundle initializes; the provider possibly
                    // later still (the owner auto-join key fetch is async) — and the bundle
                    // can REPLACE either on edit-mode re-init. attach() is rebind-aware and
                    // idempotent, so keep calling it cheaply for a couple of minutes (every
                    // save also calls it, covering replacements after this window).
                    var attachTries = 0;
                    var attachPoll = setInterval(function () {
                      attachTries++;
                      try { mgr.attach(); } catch (e) {}
                      // realtime collab FILE sync rides the same provider: wire it once both
                      // the provider and the src module exist
                      try {
                        // enableRoomSync is idempotent + rebind-aware: call it every tick so
                        // a replaced Y.Doc/provider re-binds the file-sync observers too
                        if (window.yjsProvider && window.srcState && window.srcState.enableRoomSync) {
                          var pu = new URL(window.yjsProvider.url);
                          window.__roomSrcWired = true;
                          window.srcState.enableRoomSync({
                            docName: decodeURIComponent(pu.pathname.slice(1)),
                            httpOrigin: (pu.protocol === "wss:" ? "https://" : "http://") + pu.host,
                            getYDoc: function () { return window.yDoc || null; },
                            getAwareness: function () { return window.yjsAwareness || null; },
                            isPeerPresent: function () { try { return window.yjsAwareness.getStates().size > 1; } catch (e) { return true; } },
                          });
                        }
                      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
                      if (attachTries > 240) clearInterval(attachPoll);
                    }, 500);
                  } catch (e) { console.error("save-checkpoint module init failed:", e); }
                };
                document.body.appendChild(el);
              }
              function hookApp() {
                if (!window.app || typeof window.app.on !== "function") return false;
                if (window.app.appInteractionState === "edit") loadAgent();
                window.app.on("AppInteractionStateChange", function () {
                  if (window.app.appInteractionState === "edit") loadAgent();
                });
                return true;
              }
              if (!hookApp()) {
                var t = setInterval(function () { if (hookApp()) clearInterval(t); }, 300);
              }
            })();
          }
        </script>

    </body>
</html>
